authority: XPath 3.1 F&O 4.7.4 on both sides: the integer part groups regularly at G=3, and the fractional part records position {3}, which 4.7.5 fills because the six-digit fraction has a digit that far from the decimal separator. F&O 4.7.3 also notes that "any digit can be used in the picture string to represent a mandatory digit", so '9' and '0' are interchangeable.
